# Team Memory — Dublin Environment

Shared, pre-seeded memories for every developer on the team. Installed via
`./install.sh team` into the project's agent memory. These are durable team
facts — not personal preferences.

- [Zero Hallucinations](zero-hallucinations.md) — verify before asserting; "I don't know" is valid
- [Finish Now](finish-now.md) — no deferring; finish what's possible or name the blocker
- [Change Safety](change-safety.md) — snapshot + rollback + comms before any prod write
- [Foundation-First Frontend](foundation-first-frontend.md) — dual theme day 1, CLS < 0.05, icon budget
- [Forbidden AI Tells](forbidden-ai-tells.md) — LILA BAN, Jane Doe, Filler Word Index, Pure Black, etc.
